factions.zh: 廠牌專訪／AOTD 暗 ambient 與田野錄音

albums.label: Room40
albums.why: Room40 廠牌專訪點名的早期基石：Lawrence English 說它「嚇人」，風琴被壓成不安的長音；無鼓、低頻厚、陰冷，落頹靡。

moodGuess.why: 無鼓，風琴長音低暗不安，殘響厚，陰冷

albums.bcdaily: English: 'I remember… being completely frightened… he finds a way to make the organ so unsettled but so compelling.'

albums.label: Touch
albums.why: Touch 廠牌專訪稱它與《El Tren Fantasma》同為田野錄音經典；冰島風暴與地底轟鳴，無拍、低頻厚、陰冷。

moodGuess.why: 田野錄音，風暴與地底低頻轟鳴，無拍無旋律，陰冷

albums.bcdaily: His later Touch albums, including Weather Report and El Tren Fantasma, are classics in the genre.
albums.uncertain: MB secondary-type 為 Field recording（非 live／compilation）；Y 貼 0.9，主線可評估

albums.label: Western Vinyl
albums.why: Bandcamp Daily Album of the Day：Dawn of Midi 鼓手完全不打鼓，低音長音與地下隧道般的暗色音場，無鼓、低頻厚、冷。

moodGuess.why: 無鼓類比合成器低音長音，隧道般暗沉，冷

albums.label: Lea Bertucci
albums.why: Album of the Day：以煉油廠爆炸與工業腐朽為題，弦樂長音如霧；不安但沉，落頹靡（弓弦後段有張力）。

moodGuess.why: 弦樂長音霧與低頻，有鈸滾動但不推進，陰冷

albums.bcdaily: A disquieting, yet serene, reflection on industrial decay
albums.uncertain: 僅 4 軌（兩首長作，MB 年份 2023-12-01）；後段 'feverish fury' 弓弦有張力，X 可能 >2.7

albums.label: Phantom Limb
albums.why: Album of the Day：The Bug 化名 KRM 與 KMRU 合作，Techno Animal 式 illbient 回歸，泥濘、令人不安、無四拍推進，落頹靡。

moodGuess.why: dub 低頻與顆粒雜訊，慢、泥濘、不安，無四拍

albums.bcdaily: The end result is enveloping and uneasy… sludgy and imperturbable

mbAbsenceProof.conclusion: MusicBrainz release-group search returned no matching Album for this artist/title; identity fixed by Bandcamp page and Bandcamp Daily review.

albums.uncertain: Bandcamp 日期 2024-06-14；6 軌，需主線確認總長 ≥30 分；KMRU 人聲段是否偏暖

albums.label: Tegh
albums.why: Album of the Day：伊朗聲音藝術家與小提琴手的五首長曲，被拉扯刮擦的弦與金屬質地，評者稱「不安」「遊戲配樂般」，落頹靡。

moodGuess.why: 被撕裂的小提琴與金屬打擊音，緩慢、詭異、冷

albums.bcdaily: five lengthy, languorous tracks are tricky, stirring, even unsettling
albums.uncertain: 評介寫 'stalks… sniping and biting' 有張力，X 可能 >2.7；金屬打擊

albums.label: Drawing Room Records
albums.why: Album of the Day 稱它「哥德 ambient」：氣音人聲與耳語 drone 的漂流，無推進；偶有節奏段，色溫偏冷。

moodGuess.why: 耳語 drone 與鐘聲電子，人聲漂浮，無鼓推進，冷霧

albums.bcdaily: the gothic ambient album of the summer… the predominant vibe here is drift
albums.uncertain: z -0.5 偏邊；人聲旋律 + 'Render Arcane' 有節奏段；MB 年份 2017-12，Bandcamp 2018-07

albums.label: The Flenser
albums.why: Album of the Day 與 2017 專訪稱其「威士忌與悲傷」的 doomgaze：慢速吉他牆、delay 與合成器，陰鬱。

moodGuess.why: 慢速 fuzz 吉他與 delay 厚霧，低吼人聲，鼓稀疏，陰

albums.bcdaily: Thom Wasluck… 'whiskey and sadness'… Below the House (BCD review of the follow-up recalls it)
albums.uncertain: BCD 出處是後作《It's Closeness, It's Easy》評介回顧本張；有鼓有人聲，x 貼邊

albums.label: WordSound
albums.why: WordSound 廠牌專訪：Kevin Martin 以 Macro Dub Infection 脈絡做出的首張 The Bug；dub 低頻、焦油般 bass，慢、暗、冷。

moodGuess.why: dub／illbient 慢拍，焦油般低頻與顆粒，冷暗

albums.bcdaily: That project, Tapping the Conversation, was the first album by The Bug, and was released in 1997.
albums.uncertain: BCD 只一句帶過；有慢拍，需確認不落亢奮；同廠牌 illbient 線 md36 已掃過

albums.album: Secrets of the Past and Future
albums.label: WordSound
albums.why: WordSound 廠牌專訪：波斯旋律、藏僧誦唱與手鼓包在「震顱的低頻」裡，暗黑 world-dub，慢、重。

moodGuess.why: 慢手鼓、僧侶誦唱與厚重 bass 墊，冷暗

albums.bcdaily: Persian melodies, chanting Gyuto monks, and hand percussion, enveloped in skull-vibrating bass
albums.uncertain: MB 條目無 primary-type（None），可能需走人工身分；旋律＋誦唱，z 偏邊

albums.label: WordSound
albums.why: WordSound 廠牌專訪：Fernando 的末日感器樂嘻哈，Herrmann 式弦樂刺音與偏頭痛般的合成低音；慢、暗、冷。

moodGuess.why: 慢而沉的 beat，弦樂刺音與厚重合成低音，陰暗

albums.bcdaily: an apocalyptic instrumental hip-hop album… music that'll make you look over your shoulder
albums.uncertain: 有 beat（嘻哈）但無攻擊性；字面是 instrumental hip-hop，若主線覺得該屬 hiphop 線可汰

albums.label: Masma Dream World
albums.why: Album of the Day：「儀式感十足的暗黑 ambient」，以可塑的人聲做祈禱般的召喚；慢、暗，陰森神祕。

moodGuess.why: 暗黑 ambient 人聲吟唱與低頻墊，儀式感，慢

albums.bcdaily: a richly immersive take on dark ambient that vibrates with mystical energy

mbAbsenceProof.conclusion: MusicBrainz release-group search returned no matching Album for this artist/title; identity fixed by Bandcamp page and Bandcamp Daily review.

albums.uncertain: Bandcamp tag 含 drums／African／world；z -0.4 偏邊；人聲旋律可能偏暖

notes: Bandcamp Daily 的 Label Profile／Album of the Day 對本場景（hauntology、暗 post-rock 無鼓、暗 downtempo）幾乎沒有專文：hauntology 廠牌（Clay Pipe、Castles in Space、Buried Treasure、Mordant Music）無 Label Profile，只有 Hidden Britain《Stone Tape》合輯（不收）；AOTD 多為 2020 後新作，鼓組／人聲／明亮者占多數。
已爬 Label Profile 約 230 篇、Album of the Day 約 390 篇、Best Electronic 97 期；Kranky／Constellation／Projekt／Black Truffle／Cryo Chamber 等相關廠牌專訪的亮點盤多半已被 md7／md3／md21／md33 收走或判暖／帶鼓。

刻意不收：Even the Horizon Knows Its Bounds（鋼琴、浮升）、Chthonic（MB 為 EP）、Instead of Rain I Bring a Hat（有鼓、人聲、管弦）、Nattdett（BCD 無聲音描述）、Cremation Lily（trap 鼓）、Apparitions《Volcanic Reality》（鼓組）、Daniel Wyche（BCD 稱烏托邦式、非暗）、Hammock／Stars of the Lid／Loscil（暖）。
照實交 12 張，未湊數到 27。
